cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 defining, one prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4, no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1). Coco-Glucoside @9 is after the E3 point and is recorded only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - two prominent hydrolyzed proteins (Keratin @5, Collagen @6), a late cationic guar @19, weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate @10, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @12), late Glycol Distearate @13 and Hydrogenated Castor Oil @16 - give noticeable but bounded rinse-off care. C2 not met (no prominent silicone or payload lipid, no humectant route). The only slip agent (guar) is post-fragrance, so low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - hydrolyzed proteins plus a trace post-fragrance guar and weak refatters
weightPotential.persistence: low - hydrolyzed proteins are water-soluble low-persistence film; guar at trace level; lipid non-material
weightPotential.counterevidence: Several deposition families are present (protein, cationic, weak refatter, non-material lipid); proteins are prominent.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence and the buffered SLES chassis rinses it; no silicone, no material lipid.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the only cationic route (guar @19) sits after the fragrance and its declared allergens (trace), the prominent families are hydrolyzed proteins (low persistence), the refatters are weak, and the only payload lipid (Hydrogenated Castor Oil @16) is non-material under the W-line @7; a moderate reset faces only these light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Multiple light families interact (W2); protein share unknown
weightPotential.rationale: Low: light, low-persistence deposition (hydrolyzed proteins, trace guar, weak refatters, non-material HCO) against a buffered SLES reset (6.6, W2, W-LINE). Neighbor moderate.

careDirection.limitation: Formula-only; two hydrolyzed proteins plus weak support; no humectant route

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Cationic and refatting support is late/weak; repair cluster rests mainly on two hydrolyzed proteins
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): no claim direction; formula verdict repair_supported (two prominent proteins plus cationic/refatter support). Placeholder general until claims are revealed.
focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional general (claim-dependent, 7.2); repair is the formula-compatible candidate.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL: default regular; frequent possible only with explicit frequency wording (cleansing not strong, U2).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL: CSA not met - no E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent (Glyceryl Oleate @10 is after the E3 point) and MB is excluded by prominent Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2. Even with a sensitive/dry claim the formula half would fail.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: complete INCI contains no Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole or Selenium Sulfide/Disulfide (Section 11).

uncertainties: Weight low vs moderate: chose low because the only cationic is post-fragrance trace and the other routes are light; moderate recorded as neighbor.
